topic: Session data transfer and model requirements
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on transferring session data from a specific date range (9/11) and the subsequent impact on model usage. Someone confirmed they could transfer the sessions and potentially aggregate data, which would eliminate the need to run the model.

[p3] expressed concern about the quality of the current source data. The conversation concluded with an agreement to check the results once the data is transferred.
decisions: Session data will be transferred from 9/11 for a specified period.
